newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Strong earthquake detected over Philippines.
newsitem.headline: Strong earthquake detected over Philippines.

text.p: An intense earthquake was recorded over the Philippines on Wednesday, the Hong Kong Royal Observatory said in a statement.

The epicentre of the quake, estimated at 5.9 on the Richter scale and detected at 0325 Wednesday local time (1925 GMT Tuesday), was initially determined to be across East Mindanao Island, about 350 km (217 miles) southeast of Cebu.
No further information was immediately available.
